name: Best Western Plus Hotel Alpenrose
beschreibung: The Best Western Plus Hotel Alpenrose is a hotel in Kufstein in Tyrol. The property is centrally located and offers access to the sights of the town. The hotel has comfortably furnished rooms and suites. A breakfast buffet is offered to guests. There is also a restaurant serving regional and international cuisine. Wellness facilities such as a sauna and a fitness room complete the offer. Meeting rooms for business events are also available.
